title: Digital Marketing Executive, Meta Ads, Google Ads, Oxford, COR7681
description:
Digital Marketing Executive, Meta Ads, Google Ads, Oxford, COR7681

A Digital Marketing Executive opportunity has arisen with a growing startup in the South East of England. If you are looking to take ownership of paid digital campaigns in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment where your work makes a visible impact, could this be the role for you?

The Role

The Digital Marketing Executive will be responsible for planning, managing and optimising paid advertising campaigns across both Meta and Google Ads platforms. You will take the lead on day-to-day campaign activity, monitoring performance and making data-led adjustments to improve results. This is a hands-on, in-office position based five days a week, suited to someone who enjoys a varied workload and thrives in a collaborative, close-knit team.

The Company

This is a young, ambitious business operating in the digital space, with a small and driven team that moves quickly and values fresh thinking. The company is based in Oxford and offers a genuinely supportive culture where individual contributions are recognised and there is real scope to grow alongside the business.

What experience does the Digital Marketing Executive need?
- Previous experience running paid digital marketing campaigns
- Ability to plan and manage Google and Meta Ads campaigns, including performance tracking and audience targeting
- A good understanding of digital marketing principles and how paid channels fit into the broader marketing mix
- Strong analytical thinking and the ability to use campaign data to inform decisions and report on results

So What's Next?

If you are a Digital Marketing Executive and would like to learn more, please apply below and I will be in touch with you shortly to discuss the role further.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive
Hybrid Full Time Permanent
About the Employer
An established UK technology business providing IT infrastructure, data protection, disaster recovery and enterprise technology solutions to organisations across a range of sectors. Working closely with leading global technology vendors, the company combines specialist technical expertise with long-standing industry experience to help customers protect, manage and modernise business-critical IT environments.
The Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a hands-on Marketing Executive to join a growing B2 B technology marketing team. This practical, delivery-focused position will play an important role in turning marketing strategies into effective, measurable campaigns across digital channels.
Working closely with marketing, sales and SDR colleagues, you will build and manage campaigns in HubSpot, create landing pages and email sequences, develop marketing assets, support PPC and social media activity, and monitor campaign performance. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised marketer looking to develop their expertise in B2 B technology, campaign management and digital marketing.
Duties & Responsibilities
- Build and manage integrated marketing campaigns in HubSpot, including emails, landing pages, forms, lists, workflows and associated campaign assets.
- Maintain and organise the HubSpot portal to ensure campaigns, marketing assets, data and reporting remain accurate and consistent.
- Produce campaign reports and dashboards, monitoring marketing performance against agreed KPIs and objectives.
- Create professional landing pages, email campaigns and marketing resources in line with established brand and editorial guidelines.
- Plan, create and publish engaging social media content, particularly for LinkedIn, while supporting paid digital and PPC campaigns.
- Collaborate with marketing, SDR and sales teams to understand briefs and deliver both long-term campaigns and fast-turnaround marketing projects.
- Create and adapt visual marketing assets using Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud applications, while supporting website content development and management.
- Support channel and co-marketing campaigns with major technology vendors and strategic partners.

Education & Skills Required
- A degree in marketing or a related discipline, or an equivalent professional marketing qualification such as CIM, would be advantageous.
- Previous marketing experience, ideally within B2 B IT, technology or a channel environment such as a vendor, reseller, MSP or technology partner.
- Strong HubSpot skills covering campaign creation, management, automation, organisation, reporting and performance measurement.
- Experience creating professional landing pages, email campaigns, digital marketing content and associated campaign assets.
- Working knowledge of Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, combined with excellent written and spoken English and strong attention to detail.
- An organised, collaborative and dependable approach, with the ability to manage varied workloads, meet deadlines and communicate effectively with sales, SDR and marketing stakeholders. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
- Hybrid.
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:30pm.
- Banbury.
- Salary: 30 k to 35 k. (Depending on experience)

If you are an enthusiastic and detail-focused Marketing Executive looking to develop your career within the B2 B technology sector, this is an excellent opportunity to take ownership of meaningful campaigns and expand your digital marketing expertise. Apply today to take the next step in your marketing career.

title: Recruitment Marketing Specialist
description:
This is a varied role focuses on growing awareness and engagement with graduate and early careers audiences through compelling digital campaigns, content marketing and outreach activities. Combining creativity with analytics, the position involves managing candidate engagement initiatives, supporting recruitment events, and using data and market insights to continuously improve the effectiveness of attraction strategies.

Client Details

Growing B2 B organisation with offices in Oxfordshire.

Description

The Recruitment Marketing Specialist will have the following responsibilities:
- Plan and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns to increase awareness and engagement among graduate and early careers talent.
- Develop impactful content across social media, email marketing, web and digital channels to strengthen employer brand visibility.
- Manage talent marketing projects from concept through to delivery, ensuring campaigns are creative, targeted and commercially effective.
- Drive event marketing activity, creating promotional campaigns that maximise attendance and candidate interaction.
- Analyse campaign performance and audience insights to optimise marketing effectiveness and continuously improve attraction outcomes.

Profile

A successful Recruitment Marketing Specialist should have:
- Demonstrable experience within a similar recruitment marketing / talent attraction / employer brand role
- Background in digital marketing, brand communications or audience engagement
- Ability to create compelling content that drives awareness and interest
- Experience managing campaigns across social, email and online channels
- Strong planning, coordination and stakeholder engagement skills
- Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to improve campaign performance and results.

Job Offer

The Recruitment Marketing Specialist will receive:
- Salary - £40,000-£50,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- 25 days' holiday, plus other great benefits.
- Hybrid working - based Oxfordshire.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.
